tone.target: dark chiming chorus clean with spacious delay
tone.profile: dark chiming chorus clean with spacious delay
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a light compressor for definition, followed by Chorus and Distortion (set very low) for subtle breakup, leading into a US Deluxe amp model with a clean cab, finished with extensive Plate Reverb and Digital Delay to create the desired dark, spacious atmosphere.

rig.name: The Cure - Pictures Of You - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth out dynamics and give the clean signal a consistent, defined attack.
Provide a subtle, broken-up edge to the clean tone without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is used here for its gentle breakup character, mimicking light grit rather than full overdrive.

blocks.purpose: Create the signature 'shimmering' and wide stereo chorus effect.
Provide a clean, bright, and articulate foundation suitable for jangle pop/chorus tones.
Select a bright and focused cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe amp.
Slightly boost the high end and presence to enhance the chiming quality.
Create a wide, lush, and dark atmospheric wash (plate reverb is ideal for this genre).
Provide the spacious 'delay wash' and layered echo effect.

improvements.summary: Enhance the dark, ethereal atmosphere by selecting a darker, more resonant cabinet IR to complement the clean US Deluxe tone.

proposals.reason: A darker cab will deepen the overall sound and enhance the 'dark' atmosphere required for The Cure.
